mode.title: Choose configuration mode
mode.description: Normal mode guides configuration from published RHI domains and concepts. Developer diagnostics mode additionally allows technical observation of installed Home Assistant integrations outside a domain concept.

technical_integrations.title: Developer technical observation
technical_integrations.description: Optional. {available_count} installed integration(s) are not currently used by a configured domain concept. Select only integrations you want Foundation to observe technically for diagnostics.

technical_devices.title: Choose technical-observation devices ({position})

no_configurable_domains.title: No configurable RHI domains available
no_configurable_domains.description:
Normal mode requires at least one valid domain publication containing one or more DomainBuildSpecifications.

Current domain publication status:
{publication_status}

Foundation will not invent domain concepts or silently fall back to technical guessing. Review the affected submodule diagnostics, then reopen Foundation configuration after the publication issue is corrected.
